brand.name: Stats for Spotify
brand.description: Stats for Spotify turns Spotify listening data into rankings, snapshots, trend charts, and social taste views.

hero.label: Spotify-native stats
hero.lead: Track top artists, songs, albums, genres, snapshots, and friend taste shifts from one private Spotify-connected dashboard.
hero.command: Stats for Spotify tracks my changing music taste.

sections.body: Spotify shows what is playing now. Stats for Spotify keeps the longer record: who keeps climbing, which albums return, and how your taste changes across time.

headline.text: Four views turn listening data into

sections.body: Rankings, snapshots, recaps, and friend views give the dashboard a compact system for reading your music taste.
